name: Roger Clevenger
title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Principal-level SRE and DevOps engineer focused on reliable cloud infrastructure, observability, incident response, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, distributed systems, and operational automation.
engineeringPrinciples: Bound the cost of being wrong
Separate implemented behavior from planned work

publicProjects.name: Sports Gamecast
publicProjects.engineeringDecision: Keep the application static and dependency-light while using defensive runtime behavior and deterministic browser tests to control uncertainty in upstream sports data.
publicProjects.boundary: The current sports data dependency is undocumented and is not represented as a supported production contract.

publicProjects.name: OCI Ephemeral Resource Janitor
publicProjects.engineeringDecision: Require explicit lifecycle ownership and layer reversible defaults, action caps, protection policy, fail-closed parsing, and separate termination interlocks before destructive OCI lifecycle actions are permitted.
publicProjects.boundary: The janitor enforces explicit ephemeral-resource lifecycle policy; it does not infer idle resources from utilization and currently supports OCI Compute instances.

publicProjects.name: Identity Document Async Pipeline
publicProjects.engineeringDecision: Separate request acceptance from background screening and persist job state so asynchronous work, retries, and failure recovery are explicit operating concerns.
publicProjects.boundary: The project performs plausibility screening and is not legal proof of document authenticity.

publicProjects.name: Kafka on OCI
publicProjects.engineeringDecision: Treat consensus, network topology, storage, recovery headroom, and operational signals as one distributed-systems reliability envelope.
publicProjects.boundary: Executable provisioning and automated failure validation remain follow-up work.
